title: A partir de: desde (un momento determinado) en adelante

sections.content: A partir de (starting from, as of) marks the point from which something begins and continues onward. It's followed by a date, an event, or a moment -- and unlike desde, which can describe an ongoing state, a partir de puts the emphasis squarely on the starting point itself. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: A partir de diciembre de 1998, cuando Hugo Chávez ganó las elecciones presidenciales venezolanas, la política de la región comenzó a tomar un rumbo que pocos habían anticipado.
items.english: Starting in December 1998, when Hugo Chávez won the Venezuelan presidential elections, the region's politics began to take a direction few had anticipated.

items.spanish: A partir de su llegada a la presidencia en febrero de 1999, Chávez impulsó de inmediato la convocatoria de una nueva Asamblea Nacional Constituyente.
items.english: From his arrival to the presidency in February 1999 onward, Chávez immediately pushed for calling a new National Constituent Assembly.

items.spanish: Analistas señalaron que la victoria de Chávez podía marcar el inicio de un giro político más amplio, a partir del cual otros países elegirían gobiernos de izquierda.
items.english: Analysts pointed out that Chávez's victory could mark the start of a broader political shift, from which other countries would go on to elect left-wing governments.

items.spanish: A partir de ese momento, quedó claro que la historia de la región no se había detenido con el fin de la Guerra Fría.
items.english: From that moment on, it became clear that the region's history had not stopped with the end of the Cold War.

sections.content: A partir de combines with de + el to form a partir del (a partir del golpe, a partir del cual). Use a partir de cuando + clause when you need a full clause instead of a noun phrase.
